input: How long do I have to return an item?
context: Acme accepts returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return is received.
expected_output: You can return an item within 30 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and in its original packaging.

input: When will I get my refund after returning something?
context: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return is received.
Store credit is applied instantly once the return is scanned at the warehouse.
expected_output: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the return.

input: How much does express shipping cost?
context: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50 and takes 3 to 5 business days.
Express shipping costs $12 and delivers within 2 business days.
Same-day delivery is available in selected cities for $25.
expected_output: Express shipping costs $12 and delivers within 2 business days.

context: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50 and takes 3 to 5 business days.
Orders under $50 pay a flat standard shipping fee of $6.
expected_output: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50; smaller orders pay a flat fee of $6.

input: How do I reset my password?
context: To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link sent to your email.
Password reset links expire after 60 minutes.
expected_output: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link sent to your email; the link expires after 60 minutes.

input: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
context: Delivery addresses can be changed from the Orders page until the order is marked as shipped.
Once shipped, contact the carrier directly to request a redirect.
expected_output: Yes, you can change the delivery address from the Orders page until the order is marked as shipped.

input: What warranty comes with Acme headphones?
context: All Acme headphones include a 2 year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
Accidental damage is not covered by the warranty but can be added with Acme Care for $29.
expected_output: Acme headphones come with a 2 year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.

input: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
context: All Acme headphones include a 2 year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
Accidental damage is not covered by the warranty but can be added with Acme Care for $29.
expected_output: No, accidental damage is not covered by the warranty, but you can add Acme Care for $29.

input: What payment methods do you accept?
context: Acme accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.
Cash on delivery is not available.
expected_output: Acme accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.

input: How can I contact customer support?
context: Customer support is available by live chat from 8am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday.
You can also email support@acme-store.com and expect a reply within 24 hours.
expected_output: You can use live chat from 8am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday, or email support@acme-store.com for a reply within 24 hours.

input: Can I cancel my Acme Plus subscription at any time?
context: Acme Plus is a monthly membership costing $9 per month.
Members can cancel at any time from Account Settings and keep benefits until the end of the billing period.
expected_output: Yes, you can cancel Acme Plus at any time from Account Settings and keep your benefits until the end of the billing period.

context: Acme Plus is a monthly membership costing $9 per month.
Acme Plus includes free express shipping and early access to sales.
expected_output: Acme Plus costs $9 per month and includes free express shipping and early access to sales.

context: Acme ships to 35 countries across Europe and North America.
International orders may be subject to import duties, which are paid by the customer.
expected_output: Yes, Acme ships to 35 countries across Europe and North America; import duties are paid by the customer.

input: How do I track my order?
context: Every shipped order receives a tracking number by email.
You can also track orders from the Orders page in your account.
expected_output: Use the tracking number sent to you by email, or track the order from the Orders page in your account.

input: Can I use more than one discount code per order?
context: Only one discount code can be applied per order.
Discount codes cannot be combined with Acme Plus member pricing.
expected_output: No, only one discount code can be applied per order, and codes cannot be combined with member pricing.
